title: Open purchase orders export, May 2026
license: Synthetic document written for the held-out benchmark set and generated by holdout/generate_holdout.py; no third-party material. All organisations, people, addresses, e-mail domains and figures are fictitious.
stresses: three levels of nesting (purchase_orders > lines > delivery; supplier > contact/address)
arrays of objects of different lengths (1-3 lines per order)
null values (phone, dock, notes), booleans and empty arrays
non-ASCII strings kept as UTF-8 (Ø, ü, ö)
escaped double quotes inside a string value
decimal amounts as JSON numbers, ISO 8601 dates and timestamps

must_contain: Weekly call-off; see framework agreement FA-118.

notes: UTF-8 JSON (non-ASCII written as-is, not \u-escaped), 2-space indent, key order as written; no Markdown structure is expected, so headings and tables are empty. must_contain items are whole keys or scalar values that never occur inside another key or value (numbers as JSON writes them, e.g. the net total of the second order and the gross total of the first). Matching deletes backslashes and underscores, so Gasket set "Type B", nitrile also matches its escaped JSON form and po_number matches ponumber. ordered follows document order: export.system, the purchase order numbers of orders 1, 3, 5 and 6, then the summary key line_count. Totals are consistent: net = sum of line amounts, VAT 20% on GBP orders and 0% on EUR orders (reverse charge), gross = net + VAT, and summary.gross_by_currency sums the gross totals. E-mail domains are .example domains.
